title: iris pratensis
intro: Iris pratensis, commonly known as the meadow iris, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the iris family (Iridaceae). This plant is prized for its beautiful purple flowers and is native to various regions of Europe. The health benefits of Iris pratensis include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Iris pratensis include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antihistamine effects.
